NO DIFFERENTIAL COVERS A DERIVED BODY, and that is structural rather than an oversight. A LOCAL body has two producers — THIR (the crate module) and monomorphized MIR (the oracle) — and their agreement is the `derived_mir` verdict coverage.json carries per row; the local <LevelArc as Deref>::deref reads `agreed`. A FOREIGN callee has no THIR at all (that is the gap the sidecar exists to fill), so a sidecar member rests on ONE producer path with no second witness. The available second witness is execution, not extraction: the trust-ir reference interpreter and Clean's EvalIR machine running the same body (the a3 semdiff lane's three executors). Until that runs over the derived bodies, 'derived' means produced by the compiler from the callee's own MIR — not cross-checked.
